name: avoid-swe-real-extraction
description: REAL LLM receipt for the Adam-bug. Onboarded as SWE intern; user pivots to product strategy. NO pre-written patch — the real model must extract the canonical delta. Asserts the model both ADDS product_management AND does not keep software_engineering as the active target.

turns.inbound: actually I'm done with pure software engineering — I only want product strategy / PM roles now, full-time, in SF or remote

expect.grade_criteria: The candidate explicitly rejected software engineering and asked for product management / product strategy, full-time, SF or remote. PASS only if: targetRoleFunction reflects product_management and NO LONGER lists software_engineering as a target; targetJobType moved off internship toward full_time; and (if present) location reflects SF / remote. FAIL if software_engineering survives as an active target role.
